definitions.explanation: The area behind a person or thing. More formal and literary than 後ろ.

definitions.gloss: behind the scenes; background; hidden side
definitions.explanation: The hidden forces, motives, or circumstances behind an event or situation. Often used in news and investigative contexts.

examples.japanese: {背後|はいご}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{足音|あしおと}→足音：02991_ashioto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえた→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧。
{背後|はいご}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{気配|けはい}→気配：00206_kehai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じて→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧⟦{振|ふ}り{返|かえ}った→振り返る：04231_furikaeru⟧。
examples.english: I sensed someone behind me and turned around.

examples.japanese: ⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{背後|はいご}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦そびえていた→そびえる：10360_sobieru⟧。
examples.english: A mountain towered behind the building.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{背後|はいご}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{組織|そしき}→組織：03320_soshiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a large organization behind the incident.

examples.english: Behind this problem, years of social discontent lie hidden.

notes:
USAGE:
More formal and literary than ⟦{後|うし}ろ→後ろ：00683_ushiro⟧. In sense 1, often used in tense or dramatic scenes. In sense 2, commonly appears in news, analysis, and investigative journalism.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {背後|はいご}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧ (from behind)
- {背後|はいご}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧ (to go around behind)
- {背後|はいご}⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧ (connections behind the scenes)
- ⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{背後|はいご} (behind the incident)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{後|うし}ろ→後ろ：00683_ushiro⟧: behind — the everyday, neutral word for the area behind something
- ⟦{裏|うら}→裏：02178_ura⟧: the back; the hidden side — can overlap with sense 2 but also covers physical reverse sides
